development_note: Synthetic cases generated by R3 from P1's connectome/gain (qualification benchmark) belong to the development partition. Their ids must be derived from P1 (e.g. P1-syn-*) and may not use P2 data. They are not listed in split_hash, which covers the patient-level ids only.
split_hash_method: sha256 of json.dumps({'development_ids': sorted, 'test_ids': sorted}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) UTF-8

cohort_families.source: Wang et al. 2025, repo HuifangWang/VBT_INS_Stimulation commit 5367ef4 (A0002-DatasetCard)
cohort_families.site: not_applicable (simulated virtual patients; no recording site)
cohort_families.shared_components: One study family: both cases come from the same authors, the same Virtual Epileptic Patient / Epileptor-type simulation framework and the same 162-region VEP atlas (VepMrtrixLut.txt). The structural connectomes and gain matrices differ between cases (P1 SC array sha256 4073b5ab..., P2 SC array sha256 e3e2dc9f...; P1 gain 163x162, P2 gain 191x162), so the cases are distinct virtual patients. Because the generative model and atlas are shared, the development case cannot test generalisation across model families, atlases or sites; the P2 test is a held-out-patient test within one simulation family.
cohort_families.patient_overlap_with_other_datasets: None known. No other dataset is used in study-002. Real-patient origin of the Wang virtual patients (if any) is not_reported in the case artifacts; no real-patient data is in this study.

P1.use: connectome and gain for the synthetic qualification benchmark (A0001 endpoints.qualification)

P2.use: P2-ses-seegstim (P2_SEEG_ts_fit.npz) is the primary blinded test recording for EZ recovery; P2-ses-tistim is the same virtual patient and stays in the test partition

partitions.seizure_or_time_partitions: not_applicable: no within-patient seizure or time splits; every recording of a patient sits in that patient's partition.
partitions.synthetic: R3 synthetic cases derived from P1 -> development. No synthetic case may be built from P2's SC, gain or signals.

label_access_policy.test_labels: P2 ground truth (generating x0 / EZ and propagation-zone configuration) sealed in the vault as V001 (ledger seq 67, sha256 98651a7dee52aecd4e47702a591844e517d377ce28ce2013467059bc56c08b5f) before any modeling task.
label_access_policy.related_sealed_items: V002 (truth-extraction script) and V003-V006 (Wang simulation notebooks) also hold generating values and fall under the same policy. V007-V008 (P1 published posteriors) are reference material, sealed.
label_access_policy.who_may_reveal: Only the R5 outcome_evaluation task, and only after predictions (ModelBundle EZ estimate and R4 candidate ranking) are frozen.
label_access_policy.modeling_access: R3 and R4 see P2 SEEG, SC, gain and channel names only (A0009-PatientCase). They must not open examples/Sim_*.ipynb, data/*_stimulation.xlsx, studies/study-002/work/T0005/ground_truth_P2.json or any vault item.
label_access_policy.development_labels: P1 has no clinical outcome. The planted EZ of each R3 synthetic case is known to R3 by design (qualification benchmark), which is allowed because those cases are development data.
label_access_policy.reference_standard_fallback: A0009 records the P2 truth extraction as 'partially ambiguous (see QCReport)'. Per the protocol, if truth is not unambiguous the P2 endpoint is reported as agreement with the authors' reference rather than recovery of truth; R5 decides at outcome evaluation.

leakage_controls: Patient-level split: P1 and P2 are disjoint; no session, epoch, SC or gain of P2 enters development or the synthetic benchmark.
P2 truth and generating files sealed in the vault (V001-V006) before R3 starts; reveal is audited and limited to R5 outcome_evaluation after the predictions freeze.

Disclosed exposure (protocol A0001 split_rules.leakage_controls): in study-001, the R3 and R5 agents read the authors' notebooks, and a study-001 log line records that the P2 simulations used EZ x0 -2.2/-2.3 (without region names). Study-002 agents start fresh and must not read studies/study-001/ work files. This agent did not read study-001 or the vault. Any residual exposure must be reported in the final evaluation.

Shared simulation family: the same atlas and generative model for development and test may favour the pipeline on P2 relative to a real held-out patient; reported as a limitation, not as leakage of labels.
R2 curated both cases and extracted P2 truth (T0005). The CohortSplit is fixed by the protocol and does not depend on the truth content.
notes: Input PatientCases are unreviewed (pending R5 check); the split is fixed by the protocol (task allow_unreviewed_inputs). Virtual patients only; not a clinical recommendation.
